fact: The Ministry of Finance stated that the Eisali electronic collection and payment system, applied since early 2024, was fully funded by the Ministry and built by national staff with no external technical or financial aid, and that it collects all fees approved in the budget.
title: المالية تعلن عن نظام إلكتروني جديد يربط 22 بنكاً لتسهيل معاملات المواطنين
